terms.definitionEn: For a number field $K$, the ring of tuples $(x_v)\in\prod_v K_v$ such that $x_v\in\mathcal O_v$ at all but finitely many finite places, with the restricted product topology.

terms.example: $C([0,2])$ with $\|f\|_\infty=\max|f|$ is Banach: a uniformly Cauchy sequence has a continuous uniform limit.
terms.distinction: Completeness depends on the norm; the same continuous-function space with its integral norm is incomplete.

terms.example: For a cyclic permutation of $r$ equally weighted states, the orbit average equals the arithmetic mean of the $r$ observable values.
terms.distinction: The nonergodic limit need not be constant; the theorem is pointwise almost everywhere, unlike a bare norm-convergence statement.

terms.definitionEn: The classical iid central limit theorem states that for real iid $X_j$ with mean $\mu$ and variance $0<\sigma^2<\infty$, $(\sum_{j=1}^n X_j-n\mu)/(\sigma\sqrt n)$ converges in distribution to $N(0,1)$.
terms.definitionZh: 经典独立同分布中心极限定理断言：实随机变量列独立同分布、均值为μ且方差σ²有限并严格为正时，和减去nμ再除以σ√n后依分布收敛于标准正态分布。
terms.example: For independent Bernoulli trials with fixed $0<p<1$, $(S_n-np)/\sqrt{np(1-p)}$ converges in distribution to $N(0,1)$.
terms.distinction: The theorem concerns centered, scaled sums, not the original observations becoming normal. This classical iid version does not cover arbitrary dependence or infinite variance.

terms.definitionEn: The topology on a set whose open subsets are the empty set together with subsets having at most countable complement; finite complements are allowed.
terms.definitionZh: 在集合上，以空集及补集至多可数的子集作为开集的拓扑，其中允许有限补集。
terms.example: On $\mathbb R$, $\mathbb R\setminus\mathbb Q$ is open in the cocountable topology. It is not open in the cofinite topology because its complement is infinite.
terms.distinction: On a countable set this topology is discrete. On an uncountable set it is T1 and any two nonempty opens intersect; it is generally finer than the cofinite topology.

terms.definitionEn: The topology on a set whose open subsets are the empty set together with subsets having finite complement.
terms.definitionZh: 在集合上，以空集及补集为有限集的子集作为开集的拓扑。
terms.example: On $\mathbb N$, $\mathbb N\setminus\{1,4\}$ is open. Any two nonempty opens intersect because the union of their finite complements cannot exhaust $\mathbb N$.
terms.distinction: On an infinite set this topology is T1 but not Hausdorff. On a finite set it coincides with the discrete topology, so the infinite-set qualification matters.

terms.definitionEn: For a Dirichlet character $\chi$, $L(s,\chi)=\sum_{n\ge1}\chi(n)n^{-s}$ for $\operatorname{Re}s>1$, with its meromorphic continuation.
terms.definitionZh: 对狄利克雷特征 $\chi$，在 $\operatorname{Re}s>1$ 定义 $L(s,\chi)=\sum_{n\ge1}\chi(n)n^{-s}$，并取其亚纯延拓。
terms.example: For the nontrivial character modulo $4$, $L(2,\chi)=1-3^{-2}+5^{-2}-7^{-2}+\cdots$.
terms.distinction: A principal character at modulus N gives zeta with the Euler factors at primes dividing N removed; it equals zeta itself only at modulus 1.

terms.definitionEn: If a number field has $r_1$ real embeddings and $r_2$ conjugate pairs of complex embeddings, then $\mathcal O_K^\times\cong\mu_K\times\mathbb Z^{r_1+r_2-1}$, where $\mu_K$ is its group of roots of unity.
terms.definitionZh: 若数域有 $r_1$ 个实嵌入和 $r_2$ 对共轭复嵌入，则 $\mathcal O_K^\times\cong\mu_K\times\mathbb Z^{r_1+r_2-1}$，其中 $\mu_K$ 为单位根群。
terms.example: For $\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)$ the unit rank is $2+0-1=1$.
terms.distinction: The rank uses $r_1+r_2$, whereas the field degree is $r_1+2r_2$; roots of unity are the finite torsion part.

terms.distinction: This sense of distribution is a generalized function, not a probability law; point evaluation need not come from an integrable function.

terms.definitionEn: If measurable f_n converge almost everywhere to a measurable f and |f_n|<=g almost everywhere for one nonnegative integrable g, then f is integrable and the integrals of f_n converge to that of f.
terms.definitionZh: 可测函数列几乎处处收敛于可测函数 f，且绝对值由同一个非负可积函数控制时，f 可积并可交换极限与积分。
terms.example: On $[0,1]$, $f_n(x)=x^n$ is bounded by $1$ and tends to $0$ almost everywhere; $\int f_n=1/(n+1)\to0$.
terms.distinction: Pointwise convergence alone is insufficient: n squared times the indicator of (0,1/n squared) tends to zero but has integral one.

terms.definitionEn: An isolated singularity of a holomorphic function is essential if it is neither removable nor a pole; equivalently its Laurent expansion has infinitely many nonzero negative-power coefficients.

terms.example: $e^{2/z}=\sum_{n=0}^\infty 2^n/(n!z^n)$ has an essential singularity at $0$.
terms.distinction: The classification requires an isolated singularity; a boundary accumulation of singularities is not classified by this trichotomy.

terms.distinction: The extended algorithm additionally computes integer linear-combination coefficients; ordinary remainder iteration computes only the gcd.

terms.english: Euler characteristic of a finite CW complex
terms.definitionEn: For a finite CW complex, the integer obtained by summing the number of cells in each dimension with alternating signs, starting positive in dimension zero; it is independent of the chosen finite cell structure.
terms.definitionZh: 对有限 CW 复形，以零维为正号，按维数交错求和各维胞腔数所得的整数；它不依赖所选的有限胞腔结构。
terms.example: The torus has one zero-cell, two one-cells and one two-cell, so $\chi(T^2)=1-2+1=0$. A sphere has one zero-cell and one two-cell, giving $2$.
terms.distinction: This is an integer invariant, not the Euler cohomology class of a vector bundle. An infinite alternating cell count is not automatically defined; the finite hypothesis is essential here.

terms.definitionEn: The degree-one real linear operator on smooth differential forms that agrees with the differential on functions, squares to zero, and satisfies the graded product rule; in local coordinates it differentiates each coefficient and wedges its differential with the coordinate differentials.
terms.definitionZh: 光滑微分形式上的升一次实线性算子，在函数上等于通常的微分，平方为零并满足分次乘积法则；在局部坐标中对系数微分，再与坐标微分取外积。
terms.example: For $\alpha=x\,dy$ on $\mathbb R^2$, $d\alpha=dx\wedge dy$ and $d(d\alpha)=0$. Also $d(xy)=y\,dx+x\,dy$.
terms.distinction: This operation does not require a metric or a connection. It raises form degree, while a covariant derivative produces an additional covector slot without imposing alternation.

terms.definitionEn: A finite simple graph is a pair (V,E) with V finite and E a set of two-element subsets of V; edges are undirected, with no loops or repetitions.

terms.example: $V=\{a,b,c\}$ and $E=\{\{a,b\},\{b,c\}\}$ define a simple graph.
terms.distinction: Drawing crossings are not vertices unless included in V; parallel routes require a multigraph if their identities matter.

terms.definitionEn: For a 2 pi-periodic square-integrable function f, its Fourier series is sum_{k in Z} c_k e^{ikx}, where c_k=(2 pi)^(-1) integral_{-pi}^pi f(x)e^{-ikx} dx. The series converges in L2, and stronger modes of convergence need extra justification.
terms.definitionZh: 对 2π 周期平方可积函数，以其与各整数频率复指数的积分配对所得系数构成的级数称为 Fourier 级数；它在 L2 意义下收敛，更强的收敛方式须另加论证。

terms.distinction: L2 convergence, pointwise convergence, and uniform convergence are different assertions about the same coefficient series.

terms.definitionEn: In the closed symplectic setting where the symplectic form and first Chern class vanish on sphere classes, the homology over the field with two elements of the complex generated by nondegenerate contractible one-periodic Hamiltonian orbits, whose differential counts isolated finite-energy Floer cylinders modulo translation after regular choices.

terms.definitionEn: On full-level weight-$k$ modular forms, for prime $p$ define $(T_pf)(\tau)=p^{k-1}f(p\tau)+p^{-1}\sum_{b=0}^{p-1}f((\tau+b)/p)$. Set $T_1=I$, $T_{mn}=T_mT_n$ for coprime $m,n$, and $T_{p^{r+1}}=T_pT_{p^r}-p^{k-1}T_{p^{r-1}}$ for $r\ge1$.
terms.definitionZh: 在全模群的权 $k$ 模形式空间上，素数指标算子定义为 $(T_pf)(\tau)=p^{k-1}f(p\tau)+p^{-1}\sum_{b=0}^{p-1}f((\tau+b)/p)$；并以 $T_1=I$、互素指标的乘性及 $T_{p^{r+1}}=T_pT_{p^r}-p^{k-1}T_{p^{r-1}}$ 定义其余算子。
terms.example: For weight $4$, $T_2E_4=9E_4$, since the eigenvalue is $1+2^3$.
terms.distinction: This entry fixes full level and the arithmetic normalization; at primes dividing a higher level, the operator has a different formula.

terms.definitionEn: For prime $p$ and $f\in\mathbb Z_p[X]$, a simple root $a$ of $f\bmod p$ lifts to a unique root $\alpha\in\mathbb Z_p$ with $\alpha\equiv a\pmod p$.

terms.example: The simple root $3$ of $X^2-2$ modulo $7$ lifts to a $7$-adic root congruent to $10$ modulo $49$.
terms.distinction: The derivative must be nonzero modulo p in this version; multiple roots require stronger hypotheses or different lifting statements.

terms.definitionEn: A Hilbert space is a real or complex inner-product space complete for the norm $\sqrt{\langle x,x\rangle}$ induced by that inner product.

terms.example: $\ell^2$ with $\langle x,y\rangle=\sum x_n\overline{y_n}$ is Hilbert; $\|(1,2,0,\ldots)\|=\sqrt5$.
terms.distinction: A Banach space needs only a complete norm; a Hilbert norm also obeys the parallelogram identity.

terms.definitionEn: A complex-valued function on an open subset of C is holomorphic when its complex difference quotient has a finite limit at every point, with the increment approaching zero through all complex directions.

terms.definitionEn: For integer $k$ and a congruence subgroup $\Gamma\subseteq\operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb Z)$, a holomorphic function on the upper half-plane satisfying $f((a\tau+b)/(c\tau+d))=(c\tau+d)^k f(\tau)$ for every matrix in $\Gamma$, and holomorphic at every cusp.
terms.definitionZh: 对整数权 $k$ 和同余子群 $\Gamma\subseteq\operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb Z)$，上半平面上的全纯函数若对群中每个矩阵满足 $f((a\tau+b)/(c\tau+d))=(c\tau+d)^k f(\tau)$，且在所有尖点全纯，则称为模形式。
terms.example: $E_4(\tau)=1+240\sum_{n\ge1}(\sum_{d\mid n}d^3)q^n$, $q=e^{2\pi i\tau}$, has weight $4$ on $\operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb Z)$.
terms.distinction: The transformation law alone defines a weaker object; holomorphy at the cusps is an additional condition.

terms.definitionEn: For a number field $K$, the restricted product of $K_v^\times$ relative to $\mathcal O_v^\times$ at finite places; algebraically it is $\mathbb A_K^\times$.

terms.definitionEn: If F is a C^1 map near (a,b) in R^n times R^m, F(a,b)=0, and its derivative with respect to the second variable is invertible there, then nearby solutions F(x,y)=0 uniquely have y=g(x) for a C^1 map g with g(a)=b.
terms.definitionZh: C^1 映射 F 在 (a,b) 为零，且关于第二组变量的导数可逆时，附近的零点唯一写为 y=g(x)，其中 g 是 C^1 映射并满足 g(a)=b。
terms.example: For $F(x,y)=y^3+x-8$ at $(0,2)$, $F_y=12$, and the local branch is $y=(8-x)^{1/3}$ with $g'(0)=-1/12$.
terms.distinction: The C^1 conclusion is local and depends on an invertible partial derivative; at (8,0) in this example, F_y=0 and the branch y=(8-x)^{1/3} is not differentiable.

terms.definitionEn: In the iid integrable setting, the sample averages $n^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^n X_j$ converge to $E[X_1]$ almost surely (strong law), and therefore in probability (weak law), assuming real iid $X_j$ and $E|X_1|<\infty$.

terms.example: For iid Bernoulli observations with parameter $p$, the observed success fraction converges almost surely to $p$.

terms.example: $a_n=2+1/n$ tends to $2$.
terms.distinction: A finite limit differs from divergence to positive infinity.

terms.definitionEn: The limit superior of a real sequence a_n is the extended-real limit of the decreasing tail suprema sup_{k>=n} a_k.
terms.definitionZh: 实数列的上极限是其各尾部上确界构成的单调递减列的扩展实数极限，也可等于正无穷或负无穷。

terms.distinction: It records the eventual upper envelope; it is not the supremum of all terms, which includes early outliers.

terms.distinction: Only finite sums occur in algebraic linear independence, even for infinite families.

terms.definitionEn: An inhomogeneous Littlewood–Paley decomposition splits a tempered distribution into smooth Fourier multiplier pieces using a low-frequency cutoff and dyadic annular cutoffs whose sum is one; the piece sum reconstructs the distribution in S′.
terms.definitionZh: 非齐次 Littlewood-Paley 分解，用一个低频截断和一列二进制尺度圆环上的光滑频率截断分割单位，将缓增分布拆成频率局部化片段，并在缓增分布意义下重构。
terms.example: If $\psi_0(0)=1$ and all annular $\psi_j(0)=0$, the constant distribution $1$ has low-frequency piece $1$ and every higher piece $0$.
terms.distinction: The homogeneous decomposition omits a low-frequency block and requires attention to the zero frequency and polynomial ambiguity.

terms.definitionEn: A topological space in which every point lies in an open subset contained in some compact subspace; no Hausdorff condition is included in this definition.
terms.definitionZh: 拓扑空间的每一点都属于某个开集，且该开集包含于一个紧致子空间中；本定义不附加 Hausdorff 条件。
terms.example: For $x\in\mathbb R$, the open interval $(x-1,x+1)$ lies in the compact interval $[x-1,x+1]$, so $\mathbb R$ is locally compact but not compact.
terms.distinction: In Hausdorff spaces this agrees with having a basis of neighborhoods with compact closure. Without separation hypotheses different formulations of local compactness can diverge.

terms.example: Euclidean balls show $\mathbb R^n$ is locally connected.
terms.distinction: Being connected globally does not imply local connectedness, as the topologist's sine curve demonstrates.

terms.definitionEn: A Hausdorff, second countable space locally homeomorphic to relatively open subsets of the closed Euclidean half-space of a fixed positive dimension; the boundary consists of points corresponding to the bounding hyperplane in such charts.

terms.example: The interval $[0,1]$ is a one-dimensional manifold with boundary $\{0,1\}$. Its interior points have interval charts and its endpoints have half-interval charts.
terms.distinction: A manifold with boundary may have empty boundary. Intrinsic boundary differs from the boundary of an embedded subset: $S^1$ has no manifold boundary although it is its own boundary in $mathbb R^2$.

terms.definitionEn: In the finite-state time-homogeneous discrete-time setting, a process $X_n$ with initial law $\alpha$ and row-stochastic matrix $P=(p_{ij})$ satisfies $P(X_{n+1}=j\mid\sigma(X_0,\ldots,X_n))=p_{X_nj}$ almost surely for every $n\ge0$ and state $j$.
terms.definitionZh: 在有限状态、离散时间、时间齐次的范围内，给定初始分布和各行和为1的转移矩阵后，下一步状态在全部既往观测条件下的概率只由当前状态及相应矩阵行确定。
terms.example: For $P=\begin{pmatrix}0.8&0.2\\0.4&0.6\end{pmatrix}$, starting from state $0$ gives probability $0.28$ of state $1$ after two steps.
terms.distinction: The Markov property is conditional prediction from the present, not independence of successive states. Time homogeneity is a further restriction; this record uses it and finite states explicitly.

terms.definitionEn: A real function f on a measurable space (X,A) is measurable when the inverse image of every Borel subset of R belongs to A; equivalently each set {x:f(x)>t} is measurable.
terms.definitionZh: 可测空间上的实函数，若每个实数阈值 t 对应的上水平集 {x:f(x)>t} 都可测，则称为可测函数，等价于所有 Borel 集的原像可测。
terms.example: $\mathbf1_{[0,1]}$ on $\mathbb R$ is measurable despite its endpoint discontinuities.
terms.distinction: Measurability depends on specified sigma-algebras and does not require continuity or even a measure value.

terms.definitionEn: A measure space (X,A,mu) consists of a set X, a sigma-algebra A of its subsets, and a nonnegative extended-real function mu on A with mu(empty)=0 and countable additivity on disjoint measurable sets.
terms.definitionZh: 集合、其上的 σ 代数以及在该 σ 代数上非负、空集值为零且可列可加的测度，三者组成测度空间。
terms.example: $([0,3],\mathcal L,m)$ with restricted Lebesgue measure has total mass $3$.
terms.distinction: A measurable space has only a set and sigma-algebra; a probability space additionally has total measure one.

terms.definitionEn: On a measure space $(X,\mathcal B,\mu)$, a measurable self-map $T$ that satisfies $\mu(T^{-1}A)=\mu(A)$ for all $A\in\mathcal B$.
terms.definitionZh: 测度空间上的可测自映射，保持每个可测集合原像的测度。
terms.example: The doubling map on the circle preserves length although it is not one-to-one.
terms.distinction: The transformation need not be invertible; preservation of the image measure of every set is a different assertion.

terms.definitionEn: A meromorphic function on a complex domain is holomorphic except at a discrete set of poles, with the identically infinite function excluded here.
terms.definitionZh: 复区域上的函数若除去离散的极点集后全纯，则称为亚纯函数；此处约定不包括恒取无穷的函数。
terms.example: $1/(z^2-4)$ is meromorphic on C and has poles at $2$ and $-2$.
terms.distinction: Poles are allowed, but essential singularities and interior accumulation of poles are not.

terms.definitionEn: A topological space whose topology is induced by some metric.
terms.definitionZh: 存在一个度量，其诱导拓扑恰为给定拓扑的空间。
terms.example: The usual circle is metrizable by the restricted Euclidean distance.
terms.distinction: A displayed metric is extra data; different metrics may induce the same topology while having different completeness properties.

terms.definitionEn: A continuous self-map of a nonempty compact space is minimal when every forward orbit is dense in the whole space.
terms.definitionZh: 非空紧空间上的连续自映射，其每个点的正向轨道都在整个空间中稠密。
terms.example: Every irrational circle rotation is minimal.
terms.distinction: Transitivity needs open-set connections or, under suitable hypotheses, one dense orbit; minimality requires all forward orbits to be dense.

terms.example: The minimal polynomial of $\sqrt2$ over $\mathbb Q$ is $x^2-2$.
terms.distinction: The minimal polynomial is irreducible; an arbitrary annihilating polynomial need not be.

terms.definitionZh: 对正整数上的函数，若 $F(n)=\sum_{d\mid n}f(d)$，则 $f(n)=\sum_{d\mid n}\mu(n/d)F(d)$。
terms.example: From $n=\sum_{d\mid n}\varphi(d)$ one gets $\varphi(6)=6-3-2+1=2$.
terms.distinction: This divisor-poset formula uses the arithmetic Möbius function; it is not matrix inversion or a Möbius transformation.

terms.definitionEn: For a congruence subgroup $\Gamma$, a meromorphic function on the upper half-plane invariant under $\Gamma$ and meromorphic at all cusps, equivalently a meromorphic weight-zero modular form.
terms.definitionZh: 对同余子群 $\Gamma$，在上半平面亚纯、对 $\Gamma$ 不变、且在所有尖点也亚纯的函数；即权为零的亚纯模形式。
terms.example: $j(\tau)=q^{-1}+744+196884q+\cdots$, $q=e^{2\pi i\tau}$, is a modular function for $\operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb Z)$.
terms.distinction: A pole at a cusp is allowed; a holomorphic weight-zero modular form for a congruence subgroup is constant.

terms.definitionZh: 在同一环的左模之间保持加法与标量作用的映射。
terms.example: Multiplication by $2$ is a $\mathbb Z$-module map $\mathbb Z\to\mathbb Z$.
terms.distinction: The scalar ring must be specified; additive maps are only automatically $\mathbb Z$-linear.

terms.definitionZh: 具有结合的二元运算及双侧单位元的集合。

terms.distinction: A monoid need not have inverses; its invertible elements form a group.

terms.definitionEn: If measurable functions 0<=f_n increase pointwise to f on a measure space, then their integrals increase to the integral of f, allowing the value infinity.
terms.definitionZh: 测度空间上的非负可测函数列逐点单调递增于 f 时，各函数积分的极限等于 f 的积分，允许为正无穷。
terms.example: On $[0,1]$, $f_n(x)=\min(nx,1)$ increases to $1$ except at zero, and $\int f_n=1-1/(2n)\to1$.
terms.distinction: No single integrable dominating function is required; nonnegativity and monotonicity replace that hypothesis.

terms.example: A linear map $k^2\to k^3$ is a morphism in $\mathbf{Vect}_k$.
terms.distinction: A morphism need not be a set function; an abstract category specifies its own arrows.

terms.definitionEn: A smooth real-valued function on a smooth manifold whose Hessian at each critical point is a nonsingular symmetric bilinear form; functions with no critical points are included.
terms.definitionZh: 光滑流形上的光滑实值函数，其每个临界点处的 Hessian 对称双线性型均非退化；无临界点的函数也满足此定义。
terms.example: On $T^2=(\mathbb R/2\pi\mathbb Z)^2$, $f(\theta,\phi)=\cos\theta+2\cos\phi$ has four nondegenerate critical points with indices $0,1,1,2$.
terms.distinction: An isolated critical point may still have singular Hessian, as for $x^4$ at zero. Morse functions do not require distinct critical values, and their definition does not require a Riemannian metric.

terms.definitionEn: If a finite construction has k stages and every valid prefix has exactly n_i continuations at stage i, its number of completed outcomes is the product of the n_i, provided construction histories uniquely specify outcomes.
terms.definitionZh: 有限构造分为若干阶段，若第 i 阶段每个合法前缀都有恰好 n_i 种延续，且构造历史与结果一一对应，则结果数为各 n_i 的乘积。
terms.example: Three distinct books can be placed in order in $3\cdot2\cdot1=6$ ways.
terms.distinction: The available objects may depend on earlier choices; the number of continuations must be uniform at each stage.

terms.definitionEn: At a point of a topological space, a family of neighborhoods such that every neighborhood of that point contains a member of the family; here a neighborhood may be any set containing an open set that contains the point.
terms.definitionZh: 在拓扑空间的一点处，由该点邻域组成的族，使任意邻域都包含族中某个成员；此处邻域允许是含有该点开邻域的任意集合。

terms.distinction: Members need not be open under the stated convention, unlike the separate open-neighborhood sense. A neighborhood basis belongs to one point; a topology basis describes opens throughout the space.

terms.definitionEn: A normalized Hecke eigenform in $S_k(\Gamma_1(N))$ lying in the Petersson orthogonal complement of the old subspace generated by degeneracy images from proper divisor levels.

terms.distinction: Being normalized or being in the new subspace alone is insufficient: the definition also requires simultaneous Hecke eigenvector status.

terms.distinction: Some authors include the negative equation with right side -1 under the same name; this entry fixes the right side as +1.

terms.definitionEn: A perfect matching in a finite simple graph is a matching incident with every vertex.
terms.definitionZh: 有限简单图中的完美匹配是饱和全部顶点的匹配，即每个顶点恰好属于一条所选边。
terms.example: In the cycle $a-b-c-d-a$, $\{ab,cd\}$ is a perfect matching.
terms.distinction: A matching saturating only one bipartite part is not necessarily perfect. The empty graph has a perfect empty matching by the vacuous convention.

terms.definitionEn: A point $x$ for which $T^rx=x$ for some integer $r\ge1$; its least period is the smallest such positive integer, and the orbit is called periodic.
terms.definitionZh: 存在正整数次迭代后返回自身的点；其中最小次数是最小周期，经过该点的轨道为周期轨道。
terms.example: Under circle rotation by $1/3$, every point has least period $3$.
terms.distinction: A periodic point is one point; its periodic orbit (周期轨道) is the set of points visited through iteration. A least-period-r orbit has r distinct periodic points. A fixed point has period one; distinguish a return time from the least period.

terms.definitionEn: A permutation of a finite set X is an ordering of all its elements, equivalently a bijection from {1,…,|X|} to X. An n-element set has n! such orderings, including one empty ordering when n=0.
terms.definitionZh: 有限集合 X 的排列是其全部元素的一种顺序，也可看成从 {1,…,|X|} 到 X 的双射；空集有一个空排列。
terms.example: The order $(c,a,b)$ is one permutation of $\{a,b,c\}$.
terms.distinction: This record uses full orderings; some counting texts also call shorter injective strings permutations. A self-bijection requires a chosen identification with positions.

terms.definitionEn: If n objects are assigned to m ≥ 1 categories, at least one category contains at least the ceiling of n/m objects; in particular n>m forces a repeated category.
terms.definitionZh: 将 n 个对象分入 m≥1 个类别，至少一类含有不少于 n/m 向上取整个对象；特别地，n>m 时必有一类至少含两个对象。
terms.example: Among nine integers, at least three have the same residue modulo four.
terms.distinction: The claim guarantees some category, not any designated category; distinct objects may have identical values.

terms.example: On an oriented closed surface, degree-one cohomology is dual by cap product to degree-one homology.
terms.distinction: Noncompact manifolds require compact supports or locally finite homology; manifolds with boundary require the relative Lefschetz version.

terms.definitionZh: 保概率系统中，可测集合内几乎所有点在正向迭代下无穷多次返回该集合的定理。
terms.example: A rotation preserving circle length has almost-everywhere returns to any measurable arc.
terms.distinction: Finite total measure is essential for this conclusion; translation on the integers with counting measure can have no returns.

terms.definitionZh: 流的一条横截面上，把有首次正时间返回的点送至其下一次交点的映射。
terms.example: For unit-speed motion around a circle, a section at one point has return time $1$ and identity return map.
terms.distinction: A return time must exist; a return map is not generally the time-one map and depends on the section.

terms.definitionEn: A sequence of real functions f_n on E converges pointwise to f if for each fixed x in E the scalar sequence f_n(x) converges to f(x).
terms.definitionZh: 实函数列在集合 E 上点点收敛，是指固定任一点 x 后，数列 f_n(x) 收敛于 f(x)；所需指标可以随 x 改变。
terms.example: $x^n$ on $[0,1)$ tends pointwise to zero, although its supremum is always $1$.
terms.distinction: Pointwise convergence need not preserve continuity or imply uniform convergence.

terms.definitionEn: For $\lambda>0$, a law on nonnegative integers with $P(X=k)=e^{-\lambda}\lambda^k/k!$.
terms.definitionZh: 在非负整数上取值、k处概率为指数因子与λ的k次方除以k阶乘的分布，参数λ为正。
terms.example: For $\lambda=2$, $P(X=0)=e^{-2}$ and $E[X]=2$.
terms.distinction: The parameter is the mean count, not the probability of a single event; both mean and variance equal lambda.

terms.definitionEn: The Poisson equation is an inhomogeneous Laplace equation -Delta u=f on an open set, with prescribed source f; using Delta u=f instead changes the sign convention for the source.
terms.definitionZh: Poisson 方程是带给定源项的非齐次 Laplace 方程，此处约定 -Δu=f；若采用 Δu=f，则右端符号相应改变。
terms.example: In $\mathbb R^n$, $u(x)=-|x|^2/(2n)$ satisfies $-\Delta u=1$.
terms.distinction: Poisson equation names a PDE; Poisson distribution names a probability law and is a separate sense.

terms.definitionEn: For rate $\lambda>0$, a right-continuous counting process $N_t$ starting at zero with stationary independent increments and $N_t-N_s\sim\operatorname{Pois}(\lambda(t-s))$ for $s<t$.
terms.definitionZh: 从0出发、右连续的计数过程，不相交区间增量独立，s至t的计数增量服从参数λ(t−s)的泊松分布。
terms.example: For rate $3$, the probability of no arrival in two time units is $e^{-6}$.
terms.distinction: A Poisson random variable describes one count; a Poisson process specifies the joint evolution of counts.

terms.definitionEn: An isolated singularity a of f is a pole of order m>=1 if f(z)=g(z)/(z-a)^m near a with g holomorphic and g(a) nonzero.
terms.definitionZh: 孤立奇点 a 附近若 f 可写为全纯函数 g 除以 (z-a)^m，且 g(a) 不为零、m 为正整数，则 a 是 m 阶极点。
terms.example: $f(z)=(z+3)/(z-1)^2$ has a pole of order $2$ at $1$ since the numerator there is $4$.
terms.distinction: At a pole the Laurent principal part is finite and nonempty; an essential singularity has infinitely many negative terms.

terms.example: The sphere $\mathbb C\cup\{\infty\}$ has compatible coordinates $z$ away from infinity and $w=1/z$ near infinity.
terms.distinction: A Riemann surface has complex coordinate structure; a Riemannian surface has a metric. This entry requires connectedness and excludes boundary points, while some authors use a disconnected convention.

terms.distinction: A geodesic need not minimize length between distant endpoints. A full great-circle traversal is a geodesic although its endpoints can coincide; arbitrary reparametrization may destroy the equation.

terms.definitionEn: If f and g are holomorphic near the closure of a bounded domain with piecewise smooth boundary and |g-f|<|f| on that boundary, then f and g have the same number of interior zeros, with multiplicity.

terms.example: On $|z|=2$, $f=z^3$ and $g=z^3+z+1$ satisfy $|g-f|\le3<8$; hence g has three zeros inside.
terms.distinction: The strict estimate is needed on the boundary, not throughout the interior; it counts zeros without locating them.

terms.definitionEn: A smooth map between smooth manifolds whose differential is injective at every point of its domain.
terms.definitionZh: 光滑流形之间的光滑映射，在定义域的每一点，其切映射均为单射。
terms.example: The map $\mathbb R\to S^1$, $t\mapsto(\cos t,\sin t)$ is an immersion because $(-\sin t,\cos t)$ never vanishes, but it is not injective.
terms.distinction: Immersion is a differential-rank condition. An embedding also requires a homeomorphism onto the image with its subspace topology; immersion alone imposes neither global injectivity nor that topology.

terms.definitionEn: A Hausdorff, second countable space locally homeomorphic to open subsets of a fixed Euclidean space, together with a smooth structure represented by charts whose transition maps are infinitely differentiable; boundary is excluded here.
terms.definitionZh: 具有 Hausdorff 性和第二可数性、局部同胚于固定维数欧氏空间开集，并配有坐标变换无穷次可微的微分结构的空间；本条不含边界。
terms.example: The unit sphere $S^2$ is smooth: near a point with $z\ne0$, solve $z=\pm\sqrt{1-x^2-y^2}$ to obtain local coordinates.
terms.distinction: Local Euclidean topology alone does not choose a smooth structure. The union of two crossing coordinate axes fails even the manifold condition at the crossing.

terms.definitionEn: A smooth map between smooth manifolds whose differential is surjective at every point of the domain; surjectivity of the map itself is not required.
terms.definitionZh: 光滑流形之间的光滑映射，在定义域每一点的切映射均为满射；不要求原映射整体为满射。
terms.example: The projection $(x,y)\mapsto x$ is a submersion $\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R$. The map $x\mapsto x^2$ fails at zero because its differential there is zero.
terms.distinction: A submersion is locally a coordinate projection. A surjective smooth map can have critical points, so surjectivity of the map is a different condition.

terms.definitionEn: A smooth projection over a smooth manifold with finite-dimensional real vector spaces of fixed rank as fibers and local product trivializations that are linear on each fiber; the changes between trivializations are smooth invertible linear maps.
terms.definitionZh: 光滑流形上的光滑投影，其纤维是固定有限维数的实向量空间，且有在每根纤维上线性的局部乘积平凡化；平凡化之间的变换为光滑的可逆线性映射。
terms.example: The quotient of $[0,1]\times\mathbb R$ by $(0,t)\sim(1,-t)$ is a real line bundle over $S^1$; its sign reversal makes it nontrivial.
terms.distinction: A fiber bundle may have nonlinear fibers and transition functions. In a vector bundle each fiber has linear operations, but vectors in different fibers cannot be added without extra choices.

terms.definitionEn: A smooth section of the tangent bundle of a smooth manifold: it assigns to each point a tangent vector at that point, with smooth coefficient functions in every coordinate chart.
terms.definitionZh: 光滑流形切丛的光滑截面，即在每一点选取该点的切向量，且在每个局部坐标中各系数函数都光滑。
terms.example: On $\mathbb R^2$, $X=-y\partial_x+x\partial_y$ is smooth and tangent to each centered circle since $X(x^2+y^2)=0$.
terms.distinction: A vector field assigns vectors at all points, whereas a tangent vector belongs to one point. Smoothness is stronger than continuity of a section.

terms.definitionEn: For a distribution u, its smooth wavefront set consists of pairs (x,xi) with xi nonzero for which no smooth compactly supported cutoff equal to one near x has a Fourier transform of its product with u decaying faster than every inverse power in a conic neighborhood of xi.
terms.definitionZh: 分布的光滑波前集由点与非零余向量方向的配对组成；若任何在该点附近为一的光滑局部截断，都不能使其傅立叶变换在此方向的锥邻域中快速衰减，则该配对属于波前集。
terms.example: For the Dirac distribution at $a$ in one dimension, the localized transform is $e^{-ia\xi}$, so $\operatorname{WF}(\delta_a)=\{(a,\xi):\xi\ne0\}$.
terms.distinction: Singular support records positions only; the wavefront set also records covector directions and excludes the zero covector.

terms.definitionEn: For open Omega in R^n, an integer k>=0, and 1<=p<=infinity, W^{k,p}(Omega) consists of Lp equivalence classes whose distributional derivatives of every order at most k are represented by Lp functions.
terms.definitionZh: 对欧氏空间开集、非负整数 k 及 1≤p≤∞，Sobolev 空间 W^{k,p} 由本身及直到 k 阶的分布导数均由 Lp 函数表示的几乎处处相等类组成。
terms.example: On $(-2,2)$, $u(x)=|x|$ lies in $W^{1,2}$: its weak derivative is the sign function, with squared integral $4$.
terms.distinction: Classical differentiability everywhere is unnecessary; a jump indicator has a Dirac derivative and is not in W^{1,p} across the jump.

terms.definitionEn: For a bounded smooth domain Omega and 1 <= p < infinity, the first-order Sobolev trace is the bounded linear map from W^{1,p}(Omega) to L^p(partial Omega, dS) extending boundary restriction of smooth functions on the closure; its kernel is W^{1,p}_0(Omega).
terms.definitionZh: 对有界光滑区域 Ω 及 1≤p<∞，一阶 Sobolev 迹是把闭包上光滑函数的边界限制连续延拓所得的有界线性映射，从 W^{1,p}(Ω) 到边界表面测度下的 L^p(∂Ω)，其核为 W^{1,p}_0(Ω)。
terms.example: On $(0,1)$, the trace of $u(x)=x(1-x)$ is the endpoint pair $(0,0)$; the trace of the constant function $1$ is $(1,1)$.
terms.distinction: This record concerns function boundary values, not operator or matrix trace. Higher-order zero boundary conditions also require derivative traces. The Chinese title is a descriptive qualification of the inspected usage 迹 for Sobolev boundary values, not a claim of normative standardization.

terms.definitionEn: A spanning tree of a nonempty finite graph G is a subgraph with the entire vertex set of G that is a tree.
terms.definitionZh: 非空有限图 G 的支撑树，是保留 G 全部顶点且本身为树的子图。
terms.example: Deleting one edge from a four-cycle gives a spanning tree of that cycle.
terms.distinction: Spanning refers to vertices, not retention of all edges. A disconnected graph has no spanning tree.

terms.definitionEn: In an abelian category, a sequence of differential objects $(E_r,d_r)$ with $d_r^2=0$ and specified isomorphisms $H(E_r,d_r)\cong E_{r+1}$; the cohomological bigraded version has differential of bidegree $(r,1-r)$.
terms.definitionZh: 在 Abel 范畴中，由微分平方为零的对象 $(E_r,d_r)$ 以及指定同构 $H(E_r,d_r)\cong E_{r+1}$ 构成的序列；上同调双分次版本的微分次数为 $(r,1-r)$。
terms.example: For $C^0=ka$, $C^1=kb$, $d(a)=b$, place $a$ in filtration degree $0$ and $b$ in degree $2$; the filtered-complex spectral sequence has $d_2^{0,0}:ka\to kb$ an isomorphism and $E_3=0$.
terms.distinction: A target and convergence require additional hypotheses; even convergent $E_\infty$ terms usually determine only associated graded pieces, with extension problems remaining.

terms.english: spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators
terms.definitionEn: For a compact self-adjoint operator on a real or complex separable Hilbert space, an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors exists; nonzero eigenvalues are real with finite multiplicity and, if infinitely many, tend to zero when listed with multiplicity. Kernel vectors complete the basis.
terms.definitionZh: 实或复可分 Hilbert 空间上的紧自伴算子具有由特征向量组成的标准正交基；非零特征值为实数、重数有限，若按重数列出有无穷多个，则趋于零；算子核中的特征向量补全整个空间的基。
terms.example: For $(Tx)_n=x_n/(n+1)$ on $\ell^2$ with $n\ge1$, the coordinate vectors form an eigenbasis and the nonzero eigenvalues $1/(n+1)$ tend to zero.
terms.distinction: This is the compact self-adjoint eigenbasis theorem, not the general spectral-measure theorem for arbitrary self-adjoint operators. Zero can be a spectral value without being an eigenvalue, and its eigenspace, when present, need not have finite dimension.

terms.example: $\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)$ splits $x^2-2$ over $\mathbb Q$.
terms.distinction: An extension in which a polynomial splits need not be its splitting field if it contains unnecessary elements.

terms.distinction: The stabilizer fixes one point; the action kernel fixes every point.

terms.distinction: For spheres the target is S^r; adding a disjoint basepoint to X changes the reduced suspension-spectrum convention.

terms.definitionEn: A process $B_t$ starting at zero, with almost surely continuous paths and independent increments on disjoint intervals, such that $B_t-B_s\sim N(0,t-s)$ for $0\le s<t$.
terms.definitionZh: 从0出发、轨道几乎必然连续、不同时间区间增量独立，且s至t的增量服从均值0方差t−s正态分布的过程。
terms.example: For standard Brownian motion, $E[B_sB_t]=\min(s,t)$.
terms.distinction: Normal marginals alone are insufficient; this definition explicitly includes continuity and uses elapsed time as variance.

terms.definitionEn: In the Brownian Itô setting, an equation $dX_t=b(X_t)dt+\sigma(X_t)dB_t$ means an adapted continuous process satisfies $X_t=X_0+\int_0^t b(X_s)ds+\int_0^t\sigma(X_s)dB_s$, with the integrals well defined.
terms.definitionZh: 在布朗运动的Itô框架下，要求适应连续过程满足相应漂移积分与随机积分之和的积分恒等式，且各积分有定义的演化方程。
terms.example: The Itô solution of $dX_t=cX_t\,dB_t$, $X_0=1$, is $\exp(cB_t-c^2t/2)$.
terms.distinction: Itô and Stratonovich conventions generally produce different drift terms; strong and weak solutions specify different relationships to the prescribed noise.

terms.definitionZh: 同一概率空间上按指标集合排列、取值于指定状态空间的一族随机变量或随机元素。
terms.example: Independent coin increments $(\xi_n)_{n\ge1}$ form a discrete-time process; Brownian motion has continuous time.
terms.distinction: The time index and the state space can be discrete or continuous independently; an arbitrary process need not have continuous paths.

terms.definitionEn: For an oriented smooth n-manifold with boundary, n at least one, and a smooth compactly supported (n−1)-form ω, the integral of dω over the manifold equals the integral of the pullback of ω to its boundary, with outward-normal-first boundary orientation.
terms.definitionZh: 对定向光滑 $n$ 维带边流形（$n\geq1$）及光滑紧支集 $(n-1)$ 形式 $\omega$，有 $\int_M d\omega=\int_{\partial M}j^*\omega$，边界取外法向在前的诱导定向。
terms.example: On the unit disk oriented by $dx\wedge dy$, $\omega=(x\,dy-y\,dx)/2$ satisfies $\int_D d\omega=\int_{\partial D}\omega=\pi$ for counterclockwise boundary orientation.
terms.distinction: The form must be smooth on the whole manifold, including its boundary. Compactness of the manifold makes the support condition automatic; noncompact manifolds need support or other justified conditions at infinity.

terms.definitionEn: For a filtration $(\mathcal F_t)$, a random time $\tau$ valued in $[0,\infty]$ is a stopping time when $\{\tau\le t\}\in\mathcal F_t$ for every $t$.
terms.definitionZh: 取非负时间或无穷值的随机时刻；是否已在t时刻之前停止，只依赖于截至t的信息。
terms.example: For a discrete adapted process $X_n$, $\inf\{n\ge0:X_n\ge1\}$ is a stopping time.
terms.distinction: A last visit before a future deadline generally uses future information; finite-valued stopping times and bounded ones are different restrictions.

terms.example: $A=(0,4)$ has $\sup A=4$, even though $4\notin A$.
terms.distinction: A maximum must belong to the set; a supremum need not be attained.

terms.definitionEn: For a homeomorphism $T:X\to X$ of a nonempty compact metric space and a continuous roof $r:X\to(0,\infty)$, the global real-time flow on the quotient of $\{(x,s):0\le s\le r(x)\}$ identifying $(x,r(x))$ with $(Tx,0)$, obtained by advancing the height coordinate.
terms.definitionZh: 对非空紧致度量空间 $X$ 上的同胚 $T:X\to X$ 及连续正顶函数 $r:X\to(0,\infty)$，将 $\{(x,s):0\le s\le r(x)\}$ 中各柱顶 $(x,r(x))$ 与下一柱底 $(Tx,0)$ 粘合，并沿高度前进所得到的全局实数时间流。
terms.example: Suspending the identity on a single point with roof $1$ gives unit-speed rotation of a circle.
terms.distinction: Compactness and a positive continuous roof give a positive minimum, preventing infinitely many roof crossings in finite time. Sarig's cited construction is a measurable suspension semiflow variant; this record fixes the topological compact-base flow convention. Noninvertible bases lead to semiflows. The inspected Chinese source calls suspension 扭扩, a documented naming variant.

terms.example: A subgroup generated by a transposition is a Sylow $2$-subgroup of $S_3$.

terms.definitionEn: A smooth two-form on a smooth manifold whose exterior derivative is zero and whose contraction map from each tangent space to its dual is invertible.
terms.definitionZh: 光滑流形上的光滑二形式，外微分为零，且在每一点由缩并得到的切空间到其对偶空间的映射均可逆。
terms.example: The form $dx\wedge dy$ on $\mathbb R^2$ is symplectic. The form $x\,dx\wedge dy$ is closed but degenerates where $x=0$.
terms.distinction: An alternating form can be nondegenerate pointwise and still fail closedness in dimension at least four. A symplectic form is the additional structure; the pair with its manifold is a symplectic manifold.

terms.definitionEn: A smooth manifold equipped with a smooth closed two-form whose value on every tangent space is nondegenerate; closed means its exterior derivative vanishes, and nondegenerate means contraction identifies tangent and cotangent spaces.
terms.definitionZh: 配有光滑闭二形式的光滑流形，且该形式在各切空间上非退化；闭指外微分为零，非退化指缩并给出切空间到余切空间的同构。
terms.example: On $\mathbb R^{2n}$, $\omega=\sum_{i=1}^n dx_i\wedge dy_i$ is closed and has invertible skew matrix, so it defines a symplectic manifold.
terms.distinction: Even dimension is necessary but does not itself provide a symplectic form. Unlike a Riemannian metric, the form is alternating and gives no lengths of individual vectors.

terms.definitionEn: A finite extension $L/K$ of $p$-adic local fields is tamely ramified when $p\nmid e(L/K)$.
terms.definitionZh: 对 $p$ 进局部域的有限扩张 $L/K$，若 $p$ 不整除分歧指数，则称其温分歧。
terms.example: $\mathbb Q_3(\sqrt3)/\mathbb Q_3$ is tamely ramified, with $e=2$.

terms.definitionEn: For a smooth n-manifold, the disjoint union of all its tangent spaces, with projection sending a tangent vector to its point and smooth local trivializations obtained by differentiating coordinate charts; it is a real vector bundle of rank n.
terms.definitionZh: 对光滑 $n$ 维流形，将各点切空间作不交并，以切向量所在点为投影，并由坐标卡的微分给出光滑局部平凡化，所得秩为 $n$ 的实向量丛。
terms.example: The field $(-y,x)$ on $S^1$ never vanishes and gives $TS^1\cong S^1\times\mathbb R$ by $(p,a)\mapsto a(-p_2,p_1)$.
terms.distinction: The rank is n, but the total-space dimension is 2n. Local product descriptions do not imply a global product description; the tangent bundle of $S^2$ is nontrivial.

terms.definitionEn: The tangent space at an interior point of a smooth manifold, or on a manifold without boundary, is the real vector space of velocities of smooth two-sided curves through that point, identifying curves with equal coordinate derivatives at time zero. At a boundary point it is the full vector space of real-linear derivations on smooth real-valued function germs, obeying the product rule at that point and using smooth extensions of half-space charts, rather than the cone of inward velocities.
terms.definitionZh: 在无边光滑流形上一点或带边流形的内点，切空间为经过该点的双侧光滑曲线速度所成的实向量空间，坐标中的零时刻导数相同的曲线等价。在边界点，采用光滑实值函数芽上满足该点乘积法则的实线性导子，借助半空间坐标的光滑延拓得到完整切向量空间，而非仅有朝内速度的锥。
terms.example: For $S^2\subset\mathbb R^3$, $T_pS^2=\{v:p\cdot v=0\}$; at $p=(0,0,1)$ this is the plane $v_3=0$.
terms.distinction: The tangent space belongs to one point and is an abstract vector space. A chosen embedding represents it in an ambient space; that representation is additional data.

terms.distinction: This is a finite expansion with a controlled remainder; smoothness alone does not guarantee equality with an infinite Taylor series.

terms.definitionEn: A tempered distribution on R^n is a continuous linear functional on Schwartz space with its topology given by all polynomially weighted derivative seminorms.

terms.example: The constant function $2$ defines $T(\varphi)=2\int\varphi$, bounded by a sufficiently weighted Schwartz seminorm.
terms.distinction: Continuity on compactly supported tests defines an ordinary distribution; Schwartz tests impose additional control at infinity.

terms.definitionEn: Maps $T:X\to X$ and $S:Y\to Y$ are topologically conjugate if a homeomorphism $h:X\to Y$ satisfies $h\circ T=S\circ h$.

terms.example: On $[0,1]$, $h(x)=1-x$ conjugates $T(x)=x^2$ to $S(y)=2y-y^2$.
terms.distinction: The conjugacy must be a homeomorphism; a noninvertible intertwining map is a semiconjugacy, and time changes define a different flow equivalence.

terms.definitionEn: For continuous $T$ on a compact space, $h_{\mathrm{top}}(T)=\sup_{\mathcal U}\lim_{n\to\infty}n^{-1}\log N(\bigvee_{j=0}^{n-1}T^{-j}\mathcal U)$, where $\mathcal U$ ranges over finite open covers and $N$ is the least size of a subcover.

terms.distinction: The logarithm base determines units; topological entropy needs no selected invariant measure and differs from measure entropy.

terms.definitionEn: For a fixed nonnegative integer n, a Hausdorff, second countable space in which each point has a neighborhood homeomorphic to an open subset of real n-dimensional Euclidean space; boundary is excluded in this record.

terms.example: The product $S^1\times S^1$ is a two-dimensional topological manifold: products of small open arcs give coordinate neighborhoods homeomorphic to open rectangles.

terms.definitionEn: A continuous self-map $T$ is topologically mixing when for every nonempty open $U,V$, some $N$ makes $T^n(U)\cap V\ne\varnothing$ for every $n\ge N$.

terms.example: The one-sided full binary shift is topologically mixing by concatenating prescribed words with any sufficiently long gap.
terms.distinction: It requires every sufficiently late time, not just one time; it says nothing about event probabilities for a chosen measure.

terms.example: $f_n(x)=x/n$ on $[0,2]$ has supremum error $2/n\to0$.

terms.definitionEn: For locally integrable u and v on an open Omega, v is the jth weak derivative of u if integral u partial_j phi=-integral v phi for every smooth compactly supported test phi. Higher-order derivatives use the sign (-1)^{|alpha|}.

terms.example: For $u(x)=|x-1|$ on $(0,2)$, splitting at $1$ gives weak derivative $-1$ for $x<1$ and $1$ for $x>1$.
terms.distinction: Every distribution has distributional derivatives, but a weak derivative in this sense must have a locally integrable representative.

terms.definitionEn: In the zero-Dirichlet Poisson problem on bounded open Omega with f in L2, a weak solution is u in H_0^1(Omega) satisfying integral gradient u dot gradient phi=integral f phi for every phi in H_0^1(Omega); other PDEs require their own test identity and solution space.
terms.definitionZh: 对有界开集 $\Omega$ 上的零边界 Poisson 问题及 $f\in L^2(\Omega)$，弱解是 $u\in H_0^1(\Omega)$，对每个 $\varphi\in H_0^1(\Omega)$ 满足 $\int_\Omega\nabla u\cdot\nabla\varphi\,dx=\int_\Omega f\varphi\,dx$；其他方程须另定测试式与解空间。
terms.example: On $(0,1)$, $u=x(1-x)$ obeys $\int_0^1u'\varphi'=2\int_0^1\varphi$, so it weakly solves $-u''=2$ with zero boundary values.
terms.distinction: A distributional identity without the specified H_0^1 membership does not impose this boundary condition or finite energy.

terms.definitionEn: A total order on a set in which every nonempty subset has a least element.
terms.definitionZh: 一个全序，其中每个非空子集都有最小元素。
terms.example: The usual order well-orders $\mathbb N$ but not $\mathbb Z$.
terms.distinction: A least element of the whole set is insufficient; every nonempty subset must have one.

terms.definitionEn: For small $C$, presheaf $P$, and $A\in C$, evaluation at $1_A$ gives $\operatorname{Nat}(\operatorname{Hom}(-,A),P)\cong P(A)$ naturally.
terms.definitionZh: 对于小范畴 C、预层 P 和对象 A，在 1_A 处取值给出 Nat(Hom(-,A),P) 与 P(A) 的自然双射。
terms.example: For the poset $0<1<2$ and constant presheaf $\{0,1\}$, exactly two transformations $h_1\to P$ exist.
terms.distinction: The direction of the hom-functor must match the variance of P.

terms.definitionEn: A nonzero element of a commutative ring whose product with some nonzero element is zero.
terms.definitionZh: 交换环中能与某个非零元素相乘得到零的非零元素。
terms.example: $\bar2$ is a zero divisor in $\mathbb Z/6\mathbb Z$.
terms.distinction: Some authors include zero itself; this record excludes it explicitly.
